sign: The fields rise and fall like a sleeper's chest. Do not wake it. Do not ask what it dreams.
hummock_herd: Isolde: The hummocks wander off at night. I herd them back. One of them used to be my husband's barn.
hummock_herd_intro: Isolde: You've been walking on a hummock that's mine. Pay or fight.
hummock_herd_defeat: Isolde: Paid in bruises. I'll take it.
